oneLiner: When evidence is corrected or retracted, GenLayer validators judge the notice and Recall blocks every decision that depended on it until its owner reviews it.
description: Recall extends the accepted Evidence Retraction Registry with an evidence workspace. GenLayer validators independently judge authentic corrections and retractions. Versioned evidence blocks dependent decisions while unrelated branches stay active. Per-registrant quotas (12 sources/24 decisions), global ceilings (256/512), authorized reporters, two UNCERTAIN results per version and 16 notices per source apply before consensus. Frozen exact hosts and DOI/PMID matches bind notices to sources. Europe PMC JSON is canonicalized; transient HTTP failures retry once. A 72-hour registrant contest preserves history; overturns remove only their blockers and preserve later owner reviews. Confirmed retractions accept only publisher reversal. Finalized StudioNet proofs cover correction/retraction, owner recovery and host/caller rejection. Contest/reversal is direct-test-only. StudioNet is simulation; host/identifier checks are not publisher signatures.

howTo.heading: Explore both recorded cases
howTo.instruction: Open Recorded case. Use Retraction and Material correction to inspect the clinical study and genetic testing study. Each snapshot shows direct and downstream authorizations blocked while the independent branch stays active. No wallet is needed.

howTo.heading: Inspect the proof
howTo.instruction: Open Proof & history. Check both consequential findings, exact citations, identifier/host checks and digests. Inspect FINALIZED success plus the two expected ERROR/rollback receipts for a look-alike host and unauthorized caller.

howTo.heading: Check live state
howTo.instruction: Switch to Live network. Evidence review (decision-a) is ACTIVE v2, SUPPORTED after owner reassessment. Downstream authorization (decision-b), correction-parent-doi and correction-child-doi remain blocked at v1.

howTo.heading: Verify or try it yourself
howTo.instruction: In Evidence workspace, inspect the identifier/allowed-host registration inputs and Submit notice controls. Registrants may authorize/revoke reporters, reset uncertainty and contest once within 72 hours. Follow the README to run npm run verify:network read-only. Contest/reversal has direct-test proof only.

expectedOutcome: Recorded cases show retraction and material correction: each source advances to v2, both dependents block and the independent branch stays active. Live network shows owner recovery: parent ACTIVE v2, child blocked. Proof includes FINALIZED success and two expected host/caller rollbacks with unchanged state. Inspect source quotas, identifier, hosts, reporters and notice counts; registrants can manage reporters/reset uncertainty and contest within 72 hours. Overturn/reversal is direct-test-only.
